notes.title: The game crash issue has been optimized! We sincerely invite players to particip
notes.content:
Dear players,

Recently, some players have reported that when they reached the ruins outside the city gate in the first level during the game, the game froze and crashed. However, this situation did not occur during the tests before the game's official release. After in-depth analysis by our development team, it was determined that when players approached the ruins area, the amount of graphic data would suddenly increase and even exceed the processing limit of some graphics cards, which eventually led to the game crashing.

Currently, we have already carried out optimization for this issue, but it is still in the testing phase to ensure that this problem is completely resolved and to bring you a more stable and smooth gaming experience. Here, we sincerely invite all players to actively participate in the testing and welcome you to report any problems or abnormal situations encountered during the testing process to us.

To express our gratitude for your support and assistance, for players who successfully report valid bugs, swordgame will give away game cdkeys for free as a token of our appreciation. Every piece of your feedback is of great importance to us. Let's work together to improve the quality of the game!

Thank you all for your understanding and patience. Wish you a pleasant gaming experience!

The swordgame Team

notes.title: V1.1 Update Log
Game maintenance and upgrade announcement
notes.content:
Due to poor game sales, I need to go out and find a job to repay loans and support my family. The game will be updated irregularly, and here is the planned content for the next update:

1. Map updates: Increase detail, fix map bugs causing players to be unable to walk.
2. Player controller update: Full support for Xbox controllers.
3. Performance optimization for each level.

The following content is unrelated to updates:
As of May 15, 2024, the game has been purchased by 2 players. Thank you very much for your support. Due to the time and financial investment required for game development, but the income from game sales is not enough to support me to continue developing the game, I need to go out and find a job to maintain my family's life and repay the loans. Making games is not an easy task, and I think marketing and distribution are more important. Research and development only account for about 10%, excluding good gameplay and innovation. Compared with other competitive games, "Souls of Shadow" has no advantage in innovative gameplay, which is a serious mistake I made. However, the situation has come to this point. Welcome everyone to leave comments for discussion.
